title: Tray chip to type_idx arming has zero automated coverage — a chip arming the wrong tier would ship silently
detail: The armed catalog index flows straight into Cmd_Place_Router.type_idx. No *_test.odin exists under app/; harness demos place via node id ("at 400ms place router_mid 20 5"), bypassing the tray. Review-brief marks wrong-tier chips a real defect.
recommended_fix: Add an app-layer test or harness tray directive asserting each router chip arms the type_idx of its own catalog entry, and the 6-chip row fits the window.

title: Brief asked for T2 of the ceiling reject; delivered golden pins the full-ceiling state with the reject unit-only
evidence:
# onto the high would reject .Router_Ports_Full (the reject count is pinned by
# the core unit test test_mid_high_port_ceilings; a rejected command cannot
# ride a demo's action log — it would latch replay_error and fail the gate,
# so the golden is the ceiling state itself, the reject is the next draw).
harness/demo.odin:249-253: case "expect": ... if len(fields) >= 3 && fields[1] == "hash" && fields[2] == "stable" { d.expect_hash_stable = true } else { return {}, fmt.tprintf("unknown expect: %s", line) }
detail: Briefing golden discipline: "New goldens: ... T2 of an 8-port / 16-port ceiling reject (.Router_Ports_Full)." Delivered T2 pins the full-ceiling state; the reject is fully unit-covered (test_mid_high_port_ceilings) and the harness parser cannot express rejected commands. Documented, low-risk substitution.
recommended_fix: Extend demo.odin with an expect-reject directive so error paths can ride demos; add a ceiling-reject demo pinning the 9th (mid) and 17th (high) draws.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: tier placement, kind-split separation (4 accept / 3 reject), terminal floor, per-tier ceilings (8/16), E10 replay all unit-pinned; router_tiers/router_ceiling goldens pin T1+T2. P1 ~80%: tray chip arming (acceptance #1) has zero automated coverage. Overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: Cover tray chip-to-type_idx arming (app-layer test or harness tray assertion); that lifts P1 to >=90% and the gate to PASS.
